h: Divine Kingship Awakens the Shared Joy of Shabbos

p: And it is not mentioned what the joy is.
"'And on the day of your rejoicing' (Bamidbar 10:10)
And in the Torah it does not say explicitly
"your rejoicing, and your festivals, and your new moons"
that is, belonging to all Yisrael.
and the holiness of the times
and therefore it says "in your festivals."
But regarding Shabbos one cannot say
for Shabbos Yisrael do not sanctify,
since it is already sanctified from the creation of the world.
For on Yom Tov they were commanded
and they rejoice on account of the command of Hashem Yisbarach
is from the side of Hashem Yisbarach.
אֲבָל בְּשַׁבָּת לֹא נִצְטַוּוּ עַל שִׂמְחָה
But on Shabbos they were not commanded about joy;
yet the Men of the Great Assembly
instituted in the text of the Shemoneh Esrei:
that is, they rejoice of their own accord
through sensing the glory of His kingship
let the children of Tziyon exult in their King" (Tehillim 149:2);
"You shall surely set a king over you"
that his awe be upon you
and on Shabbos Yisrael are called
and "the awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned"
and fear of flesh and blood
as is written in Tanna DeVei Eliyahu:
And see the Zohar at the beginning of Parshas Acharei
that on Shabbos each one is called
and sits on His Throne of Glory
with the revelation of the glory of His kingship
who bear upon themselves all day
to guard against doing any work;
דְּעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ בְּתַנָּא דְּבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ [פֶּרֶק א]
about which they said in Tanna DeVei Eliyahu (chapter 1):
and to Him is one of them' (Tehillim 139:16)
this is the day of Shabbos for Yisrael";
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה יִשְׂמְחוּ הֵם מֵעַצְמָם
and through this they rejoice of their own accord
and therefore it is called "your rejoicing":
in accepting the yoke of His kingship, may He be blessed,
(שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים ג, יא) וּבְיוֹם שִׂמְחַת לִבּוֹ
"'And on the day of the joy of His heart' (Shir HaShirim 3:11)
this is the building of the Beis HaMikdash."
is like the Mikdash in place;
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר בַּאֲכִילַת מַעֲשֵׂר (דְּבָרִים יד, כג)
as it says regarding eating maaser (Devarim 14:23):
"So that you learn to fear, etc."
when Yisrael are called "those who fear My Name,"
Therefore we say at this meal:
And at the onset of Shabbos,
which is with the addition to Shabbos
for Hashem Yisbarach knows its times and moments
and entered it by a hairsbreadth
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה י, ט)
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹקִים אֶת כׇּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made,
and behold it was very good";
regarding everything that is the opposite of good,
And it is possible that the Midrash Rabbah
did not expound from the inclusive "all,"
but rather that it refers to the attribute "Kol,"
וַיַּרְא אֱלֹקִים אֶת כׇּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
"And God saw all that He had made"
and then at the onset of Shabbos it became clear
that even though there was corruption,
except that which comes out of darkness,
except that which comes out of evil"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
(as is written in the Zohar II 184a).
And then there was the joining of the attribute of Tzaddik
And just as at the building of the Beis HaMikdash
so on Shabbos they are called "bride."
which corresponds to the attribute of Yesod,
נֶאֱמַר וַיַּרְא אֱלֹקִים אֶת כׇּל וְגוֹ׳
it says "And God saw all, etc.,
and behold it was very good";
for on Shabbos His world found favor in His eyes
And this is "Great joy will come":
both from the side of Yisrael
and from the side of the joy of Hashem Yisbarach,
which is "the joy of His heart."

Reverence Becomes Joy in the Divine Presence
